# CAD regression fixtures

Fixtures should be minimal, redistributable, and focused on one behavior whenever possible. Planned canonical coverage includes ACI/TrueColor/ByLayer/ByBlock colors, ARC/CIRCLE/ELLIPSE, bulged polylines, SPLINE, blocks/nested blocks, text/MTEXT, linetypes, lineweights, hatch and layouts.

Do not add customer drawings or files with unclear redistribution rights.
